name: The Ossuary March
purpose: First production vertical slice proving AEONFALL's combat, taming, hireables, crafting, progression, dungeon, boss, world-event, shop, persistence, streaming, and presentation architecture before broad content binding.

region.fantasy: A necrotic frontier where corpse-fed ecology, ruined pilgrimage infrastructure, blackwater marshes, grave markets, and mobile ossuary fortifications collide.

dungeon.name: The Ossuary Exchange
acts: Outer Market breach and faction choice

shop.name: The Grave Market Quartermaster
notes: The first slice validates stock rotation, unlock gating, persistence, and UI without coupling core progression to real-money transactions.
Any later monetization must be implemented only through then-current Epic-supported systems and publication rules.

acceptance_gates: Verse compiles in the bound UEFN project
Launch Session completes full dungeon and world-event loop
no permanent orphaned spawns or VFX after event cleanup
memory and spatial profiling pass target platform budgets
boss encounter supports solo scaling and coordinated squad play
tameable and hireable pathing recover from blocked navigation
shop purchases and crafting transactions are idempotent
all lethal mechanics have redundant visual/audio readability cues
